paper_title: External validation of artificial intelligence for detection of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
prediction_task: Binary classification of HFpEF cases vs matched controls using TTE-based deep-learning model (EchoGo) versus H2FPEF and HFA-PEFF clinical scores

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Substantial performance drop from internal (AUROC 0.95) to external (0.798) validation; potential causes and implications of generalization cost warrant detailed discussion.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added discussion of V1 to V2 model updates, site-specificity of Mayo training cohort, and typical optimism observed on external validation.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Categorical sensitivity/specificity comparisons at arbitrary cutpoints bias comparison vs continuous H2FPEF score (near-identical AUROC); claims of higher classification performance not sufficiently justified.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added decile-based comparisons showing near-identical performance; contextualized cutpoint-based comparisons and documented cutpoint derivation.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Selection bias concerns: ~20% excluded for image quality, ~50% for missing biplane LVEF, case/control matching before image-quality filter; adjudicator blinding unclear.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added limitation paragraph on image quality exclusions; clarified biplane LVEF was a selection criterion; explained adjudication workflow.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: NRI/IDI analyses inconsistent across figures; NRI+ and NRI- components not reported separately; percentile-based NRI not performed despite miscalibration of both scores.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Clarified NRI computation, reported NRI+/NRI- separately, added percentile-based NRI to address miscalibration concerns.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: PPV/NPV reported from case-control design with artificially inflated prevalence; not adjusted for expected real-world prevalence, hindering clinical translation.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Clarified case-control up-sampling effect on PPV/NPV interpretation in revised text.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Unexpected non-monotonic behavior: quartile 3 of AI HFpEF shows lower observed risk than quartile 2, indicating miscalibration and potential model behavior issue requiring explanation.
